secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase project anon/public key (Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → anon public). Needed for client-side data/auth.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (dashboard → Project Settings → API → service_role). Used for server-side admin operations.

secrets.name: VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe publishable key (Stripe dashboard → Developers → API keys → pk_test_...). For client-side checkout.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key (Stripe dashboard → Developers → API keys → sk_test_...). For server-side checkout sessions.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...). For verifying webhook payloads.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID (Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials). Optional, for Google sign-in.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret. Optional, for Google sign-in.
